note: SiteGuard Education videos (scripts/lib/education.mjs), shown on /education/ and /education/<slug>/ on both sites; keep this file identical in both repos. Each series (group) always has its tab and page. To add a video, add an entry to the series' "videos" list: {"youtube_url": "<the link from the video's Share button>", "title": "...", "description": "one or two sentences", "upload_date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. Optional: "duration" (e.g. "PT4M30S"), "poster" (/assets/video/...jpg; YouTube's thumbnail is used without one), "download_url" (an https link or an .mp4 in /assets/video/) to show a Download button. Videos not yet on YouTube can use "provider": "file" with "file" and "poster" in /assets/video/ instead of youtube_url. Optional "modules": a list of module slugs ("audit", "safety", "quality", "environmental", "management") to show the video under "Related videos" on those module pages. Rebuild after a change; the storefront also needs a restart.
